text:
mira_support: Heads-up — customer acme-inc seeing 502/504 spike from hosted API around 14:02 PST. Error rate ~3% on /v1/embeddings/batch. Trace IDs: 01H3abc... (attached). Anyone oncall? :alarm_clock:

alex_eng: I'm on it. Which region? logs?

mira_support: us-west-2. Customer reports it correlates with large 50k token embedding batches. We've asked for request sample — they sent curl below.

mira_support: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch 
-H 'Authorization: Bearer SK-REDACTED' 
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
-d '{"model":"embed-xxl","inputs":[...large payload trimmed...]}'```

alex_eng: thx. Quick check — deploybot shows no recent deploys to edge in last 30m.

deploybot: [bot] no deploys to edge-gateway-prod in last 60m. :white_check_mark:

jordi_sre: seeing upstream 502s from auth-proxy in logs, connection reset by peer. repeated "stream error: received RST_STREAM" on h2. Possible h2 keepalive / conn-pool exhaustion.

alex_eng: can we repro with their payload locally? mira_support can forward sample payload and api key?

mira_support: forwarded sanitized payload and trace id 01H3abc to alex_eng via secure share. Customer ok with anonymized key for repro.

sam_billing: FYI customer also flagged potential billing anomalies when requests error out — they saw token counts on failed requests. want to avoid double charge perception.

jordi_sre: temp mitigation: lowered h2 max_concurrent_streams on edge-nginx canary to 64, rolling 5% -> 20% -> 50%. watching for drop in RST/502s.

alex_eng: added fallback: if tenant 502s > 1% for 5m, enable ff/embeddings-chunk-fallback to chunk requests at 10k tokens. Pushed as config flag to routing policy.

mira_support: customer applied suggested client-side retry/backoff and error rate dropped to ~0.4% after ~12m. They want formal RCA and permanent fix plan.

jordi_sre: next steps: collect tcp dump + h2 metrics from edge and auth-proxy, check auth-proxy thread pool saturation, correlate with keepalive/timeouts, and review upstream idle timeout settings. Assigning to eng-runtime + eng-sre.

alex_eng: I'll open internal bug: INF-3721 with timeline, upload traces (01H3abc), and link customer remediation notes. Also scheduling a rollback knob if canary change regresses.

mira_support: customer requested update within 60m. @oncall_bot please set follow-up reminder 60m.

oncall_bot: reminder set for 60 minutes for thread 1758012345.

mira_support: Thanks all — updating customer that we're on a mitigation path and will share RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
